theorems.name: Submission.iwl_top_dim_integrality
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), IsOpen U → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ j, ((Tj j).massOn W + (Tj j).boundary.massOn W)) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
